newsitem.title: USA: Comdial launches digital business switch.
newsitem.headline: Comdial launches digital business switch.

text.p: Comdial Corp said Monday it was launching a third generation of digital business switches that it hopes will drive growth in the future.

Comdial said the new generation, called the FX Series, was a telephone switch designed as a platform for computer telephony integration, which enables computers to work like telephones, among other things.
"We expect sales of the FX Series and related applications software to drive our planned growth for the second half of 1997 and beyond," it said.
Comdial said it planned to start delivering the switch, designed for companies with 25 to 100 employees, in the second quarter.
